messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "dose can be adjusted every two weeks for high blood pressure"
set: ["dose can be adjusted every two weeks for high blood pressure", "high blood pressure", "taken as one dose or split into two for high blood pressure", "adjusted according to blood pressure response", "high blood pressure (hypertension)", "Untreated high blood pressure", "dangerously high blood pressure", "severe high blood pressure", "blood pressure can rise", "very high blood pressure reading", "people with high blood pressure", "high blood pressure in adults", "stroke or high blood pressure", "effective contraception for two weeks after final dose", "medicine for blood pressure", "dose cannot be adjusted with available strengths"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
